config(
    strategy='check',

)

caption: List only the columns that actually matter to track.

code:
dbt_valid_from   -- when this version became current
dbt_valid_to     -- when superseded (null = still current)
dbt_scd_id       -- unique hash for this version row

-- "what was the region on March 1?" = a WHERE clause
-- against dbt_valid_from / dbt_valid_to
